pattern: does project work itself instead of delegating
experience: Asked to move a project forward, the personal assistant must hand the work to that project's Chief Agent with delegate, with a structured brief, instead of opening threads or editing code itself.
rule: delegate: Hand project work (code, fixes, features, research in a repo) to your member's Chief Agent for that project instead of doing it yourself; find its `id` with `agent_list`.

pattern: reports without the Worker thread link
experience: When its Worker finishes, the Chief Agent reports the delegation COMPLETED with delegation_report, giving the Worker thread's link in the result instead of pasting the Worker's process.
rule: delegation_report: `report.result`: the outcome in a few lines plus the link of each Worker thread; never paste a Worker's transcript.
